document.abstract: In an era of constant progression toward ultimate miniaturization of equipment, the splitting of standard films for sound recording is normal and consistent. Improved head gap to magnetic film contact and greater compliancy in the medium made possible more compact film transport components. These and other advantages of split 16mm are discussed.
